spans.s:
f. (-तिः)
Speed, velocity, in general, or the speed of a chariot.
E.
रम to sport, क्तिन् aff., हुक् augment.

n. (-हः)
Speed, velocity.
E.
रम to sport, Uṇādi aff. असुन्, हुक् augment.

f. (-न्तिः)
1 Pleasure, sport.
2 Cessation, stop.
E.
रम to sport, क्तिच् aff.
A king of the lunar dynasty; also called Ś

A dog.
E.
रम, and देव a deity, or who sports or plays.

f. (-न्तुः)
1 A road.
2 A river.
E.
रम to sport, &c., aff. तु.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Injurious, hurtful.
E.
रध to hurt, ण्वुल् aff.

n. (-न्ध्रं)
1 A hole, a fissure, a cavity, a chasm.
2 A fault, a defect.
E.
रम to sport, aff. क्विप्, धृ to have or hold, aff. क.

m. (-भ्रुः)
A rat.
E.
रन्ध्र a hole, and बभ्रु an ichneumon.
